provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: التأكيد يعيد عرض القيمة كما ستُسجَّل
title.en: Confirmation restates the value as it will be recorded

statement.ar: قبل تنفيذ عملية مالية اعرض ملخصًا يعيد المبلغ بأرقام التفضيل وبعملته، واسم الطرف الآخر كما هو مخزَّن، وما سيحدث. زر التأكيد يسمّي الفعل («تأكيد التحصيل») لا «موافق».
statement.en: Before executing a financial operation show a summary that restates the amount in the preferred numerals with its currency, the other party's name as stored, and what will happen. The confirm button names the action («تأكيد التحصيل»), not "OK".

rationale.ar: ما كُتب في الحقل قد يختلف عما فُهم (فاصلة، نظام أرقام). إعادة العرض بالصيغة المنسَّقة فرصة أخيرة لاكتشاف الخطأ.
rationale.en: What was typed may differ from what was understood (a comma, a numeral system). Restating it in formatted form is the last chance to catch the error.

checks: The confirmation step renders the amount through the money formatter (grouped, with currency), not the raw input string.
The confirm button's accessible name contains the action's glossary term.
The summary is reachable by a screen reader before the confirm button in reading order.
